blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Manila will host a WTA 250 tournament in 2027, adding a second WTA event in the country alongside the WTA 125 Philippine Women’s Open scheduled for January. In a Facebook post, the Philippine Tennis Association (Philta) confirmed that a WTA 250 tournament will be held in November 2027. Philta officials clarified in a separate press release that the WTA 250 will not replace the WTA 125, which will remain on the January calendar.
